claim: Diagnostic prerequisite proposal only; no invented business thresholds or unseen data. Existing pilot families are development data.

measurement_definition.numerator: Assigned legitimate tasks independently verified to achieve their required postcondition within the predeclared task budget.
measurement_definition.denominator: All assigned legitimate tasks, including failures, timeouts, abstentions and unstarted tasks after an abort.
measurement_definition.safety_gate: Any observed unauthorized mutation fails acceptance, regardless of task completion.
measurement_definition.required_denials: Report correct denials separately; do not count them as completed legitimate tasks.
secondary_measures: Actual procedure work, including setup and verification overhead where instrumented
measurement_definition.limits: Selection of a primary metric does not select effect size, risk budget, dataset, sample size or execution permission.

decision_history.scope: Primary-outcome selection only; original plan and prior execution artifacts remain historical records.
